name: MatchProposals
technicalDescription: Customer proposal of a bank line, written by IdentifyCustomers (since 08.11 identification only; invoices are allocated after the debt check): who paid, how they were identified, which invoices the bank line pays, with the evidence. A human approves (אושרה – לביצוע ב-Priority), then marks done in Priority. Never auto-posted.

columns.name: bankLineId
columns.description: Bank line (text link to BankLines.bankLineId)

columns.name: valueDate
columns.description: Value date of the bank line

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Bank line amount ILS

columns.name: payerName
columns.description: Payer name on the bank line

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Identified customer code (text link to Customers)

columns.name: customerName
columns.description: Customer display name (denormalised)

columns.name: customerIdMethod
columns.description: How the customer was identified

columns.name: invoiceNumbers
columns.description: Invoices in the proposal, comma-separated

columns.name: allocations
columns.description: Allocation of the amount to invoices

source.description: פירוט במייל / הערה בגיול / סכום / תשובת לקוח / ידני

openBefore.description: The invoice's open amount before this receipt

splitKind.description: מלאה (receipt = one invoice) / חלקית (receipt < invoice) / מרובה (several invoices)

unallocated.description: Part of the transfer not allocated to any invoice (על חשבון)

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: Confidence

columns.name: reasoning
columns.description: Human-readable proof, e.g. 3 חשבוניות, פירעון 30.9, סכום זהה בדיוק

columns.name: assignedBookkeeperName
columns.description: Bookkeeper who owns the customer (display name)

columns.name: status
columns.description: Proposal status

columns.name: proposedAt
columns.description: When the proposal was created

columns.name: decidedBy
columns.description: Who approved or rejected

columns.name: decidedAt
columns.description: When approved or rejected

columns.name: priorityDoneBy
columns.description: Who marked it done in Priority

columns.name: priorityDoneAt
columns.description: When it was marked done in Priority

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).

columns.name: evidenceEmailIds
columns.description: InboundEmails ids that were the evidence, comma-separated

columns.name: evidenceQuote
columns.description: Exact quote from the evidence email

columns.name: checkRunId
columns.description: Identification run that produced the proposal

columns.name: importBatchId
columns.description: Import batch of the bank line (text link to ImportBatches.id)

columns.name: receiptKey
columns.description: Receipts.receiptKey created when this proposal was approved
